第(1/3)页

第二日，

一个个传闻在黑钻城内疯狂蔓延。

短短半日便席卷大街小巷，引得全城人心惶惶。

“听说了吗？卢西城堡被巨龙袭击了，里面所有人都无一幸免。”一个佣兵说道。

“什么巨龙？我怎么听说是一群刺客潜入城堡，袭杀了所有人呢？”

“哎，不对不对。卢西城堡可是副城主卢西伯爵的府邸，什么刺客能潜入到那里？”

有人一脸笃定的说道：“明明是一群邪卡师，他们用了一张特别强大的卡牌，将整个城堡的生灵全都献祭了。”

这个说法引得众人纷纷点头。

“有道理，我也听说了，里面不仅空无一人，甚至连一些牲畜都没有留下。”

一个商贩推着小车走来。

“不止卢西城堡呢，还有黑森子爵的黑森堡。”

“哦？怎么说？”

几人皆是一脸好奇。

“咳咳……”

商贩清了清嗓子，目光看了看自己的货物。

几个佣兵对视一眼，纷纷掏出卡恩。

“有点渴了，给我们来几个果子尝尝。”

“得嘞。”

商贩接过卡恩，麻利的取出果子递了过去。

他神秘兮兮的凑过来，小声道：

“我邻居早前接了送货的差事，按时间赶赴黑森堡送货。”

“可你们猜怎么着，城门破败不堪，城墙外也是一片狼藉，无人看守。

守卫、奴隶、仆从尽数消失了，宛如一座死城！”

众人听得满脸骇然。

“什么时候的事情？为什么我没听说过？”

“等你能知道的时候，黄花菜都凉了。”

商贩小声道：“大概应该是两天前发生的事情，千万别和别人说。”

众人皆是惶恐不已。

“看来，真的是邪卡师入侵了。”

“城主大人去战场了，黑钻城没有御卡宗师坐镇，怎么处理那群邪卡师？”

恐慌瞬间弥漫开来，有人脸色发白，低声颤问。

“连两大贵族城堡都被悄无声息抹平……接下来，他们该不会要屠城吧？”

卢西城堡和黑森城堡的两件诡异事件，如瘟疫般快速地蔓延开来。

然而，身为这两件事情的始作俑者。

林奇此时正在万卡阁内，被一众女贵族簇拥环绕，场面热烈至极。

“林奇大师，没想到你还会看手相呢。”

On the second day,

Rumors spread wildly in Black Diamond City.

In just half a day, it swept through the streets and alleys, causing panic throughout the city.

"Have you heard? Luci Castle was attacked by a giant dragon, and everyone inside was not spared." A mercenary said.

"What dragon? Why did I hear that a group of assassins sneaked into the castle and attacked and killed everyone?"

"Hey, that's not right. Luci Castle is the residence of the deputy city lord, Count Luci. What kind of assassin can sneak in there?"

Someone said with determination: "It's obviously a group of evil card masters. They used a particularly powerful card to sacrifice all the creatures in the entire castle."

This statement caused everyone to nod.

"That makes sense. I've also heard that. Not only is there no one inside, there aren't even any livestock left."

A vendor came pushing a cart.

"Not only Luci Castle, but also Hesse Castle of Viscount Hesse."

"Oh? What do you say?"

Everyone looked curious.

"Ahem..."

The merchant cleared his throat and looked at his goods.

Several mercenaries looked at each other and took out Kahn.

"I'm a little thirsty. Give us some fruits to try."

"Okay."

The vendor took Kahn and quickly took out the fruit and handed it over.

He came over mysteriously and whispered:

"My neighbor picked up the delivery errand earlier and rushed to Hesenberg to deliver the goods on time."

“But guess what, the city gate is in dilapidated condition, and the outside of the city wall is also in a mess, with no one guarding it.

The guards, slaves, and servants all disappeared, like a dead city!"

Everyone was shocked when they heard this.

"When did it happen? Why haven't I heard of it?"

"By the time you know it, the daylilies will be cold."

The vendor whispered: "It probably happened two days ago. Don't tell others."

Everyone was terrified.

"It seems that the evil card master really invaded."

"The Lord of the City has gone to the battlefield. There is no card master in Black Diamond City. How to deal with those evil card masters?"

Panic spread instantly, and some people turned pale and asked in low voices.

"Even the two noble castles were quietly wiped out... Will they massacre the city next?"

Two strange events in Luci Castle and Hesse Castle spread as quickly as the plague.

However, as the initiator of these two things.

Lin Qi was currently in Wanka Pavilion, surrounded by a group of female nobles, and the scene was extremely lively.

"Master Lynch, I didn't expect you to read palms."
